I don't think they should be added.
/Stafflist was made so the regulars know if a "staff member" a.k.a. someone with banning powers so they know if its worth doing /report or not.

replies.author: FrozenSolstice
replies.body:
No.

Think about it, if a player does /stafflist, they usually want to know if a staff member is online to contact them.

If they start talking to someone ranked with media, the media ranked player may not know how to deal with the problem.

Its happened before. Someone mistakes a non-staff rank for a staff rank, ask the user a question, and gets annoyed when they can't answer.

Media isn't a staff rank.
